description:
About our brand and products:
Dink Dynasty Designs creates premium pickleball apparel built for performance, comfort, and everyday wear. Our shirts are designed with better cuts, better fabrics, and original artwork that stands out on and off the court. Every piece is made to avoid the boxy fit and low quality feel common in most pickleball apparel.

What makes us different:
We focus on fit first. Our shirts are tailored, athletic, and flattering without feeling tight.
We use higher quality fabrics, including performance materials and premium cotton blends.
Our designs are original and culture driven, not generic sports graphics.
Our apparel is versatile enough for pickleball, workouts, casual wear, and daily life.
We care about quality, durability, and long term wear, not fast fashion.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn a commission on every sale generated through their unique referral link or code.
You get paid for introducing your audience to a premium pickleball brand they will actually want to wear.
Commission is tracked automatically and credited for approved orders.

How to promote us:
Create content wearing the product on or off the court.
Share honest reviews, fit checks, and lifestyle content.
Post reels, stories, short form videos, or static posts.
Use your affiliate link or code in captions, bios, or stories.
Focus on fit, comfort, quality, and how the shirts look compared to standard pickleball apparel.

Other information:
We encourage authentic content and creative freedom.
No misleading claims or discount stacking without approval.
Affiliates must follow platform guidelines and FTC disclosure rules.


We reserve the right to approve or remove affiliates at our discretion.
payout_period: Twice a month. The 1st and 15 of the month.
term_and_condition:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
By joining the Dink Dynasty Designs Ambassador Program, you agree to the following terms:

Participation
Ambassadors must be approved by Dink Dynasty Designs to participate. We reserve the right to accept, reject, suspend, or remove any ambassador at our discretion, with or without notice.

Promotion Guidelines
Ambassadors agree to represent the brand accurately and professionally. Content must be authentic and may not include false, misleading, or exaggerated claims about products. All promotions must comply with platform rules and FTC disclosure requirements, including clear disclosure of affiliate relationships.

Commissions and Tracking
Commissions are earned only on verified, completed purchases made through your approved referral link or code. Orders that are canceled, refunded, or fraudulent are not eligible for commission. Commission rates, payout schedules, and payment methods may change with notice.

Brand Assets
Approved ambassadors may use Dink Dynasty Designs logos, images, and brand assets solely for promoting the brand. Assets may not be altered, misused, or shared outside of approved promotional purposes.

Restrictions
Ambassadors may not bid on branded keywords, impersonate the brand, offer unauthorized discounts, or represent themselves as employees or owners of Dink Dynasty Designs.

Termination
Either party may terminate participation at any time. Upon termination, ambassadors must stop using all brand assets and promotional links.

Program Changes
Dink Dynasty Designs reserves the right to modify or discontinue the ambassador program, commission structure, or terms at any time.
